title: Specification for Letterpress Printing Plates and Equipment, Part 1: Original Printing Plates
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11122 (PART 1)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Specification for Letterpress Printing Plates and Equipment, Part 1: Original Printing Plates.
clause_3_terminology: Specification for Letterpress Printing Plates and Equipment
Specification for Letterpress Printing Plates and Equipment, Part 1: Original Printing Plates

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
